# Vega4D

Vega4D is a platform for sub-millimeter human manipulation data, captured on our own rig and shipped as training-ready tensors.

## What we do
- Capture: Twelve calibrated cameras and an instrumented glove record hands doing real work.
- Vectorize: 21-keypoint skeletons per hand with 6-DoF rotation.
- Validate: Sequences are replayed against source footage; anything drifting past 0.8mm tolerance is cut.
- Ship: Data packed into sharded tensors (WebDataset format).

## Offerings
We provide research, lab, and enterprise tiers for accessing datasets like DEX-1M, TOOL-320K, and REACH-2M. We also prepare custom datasets for specific training requirements.
